stem: Older leaves show progressive chlorosis while tissue data, root-zone readings, irrigation history, and environmental conditions are all available. Which evidence strategy is most defensible?
choices: Integrate symptom location and progression with tissue, root-zone, irrigation, and environmental data to test competing nutrient hypotheses.
Choose the nutrient associated with the most visually similar internet photo.
Use tissue data alone because plant appearance is subjective.
Use symptom position alone because it is more important than root-zone or environmental context.
rationale: Reliable nutrient diagnosis triangulates plant symptoms with tissue, root-zone, irrigation, and environmental evidence rather than relying on a single evidence stream.
